messages:
rachel: Quick question — I’m moving from CA to the UK mid-August. How will that affect my PTO accrual, any local public-holiday swaps, and the Q4 blackout?

sam_peopleops: Congrats! Short answer: accrual switches to the country policy effective your official change-of-residence date. Carryover rules still use the accrual period you were under for those days. Need to check a couple of details for public-holiday alignment.

rachel: by "change-of-residence date" you mean the HR relocation form effective date or payroll change?

sam_peopleops: HR relocation effective date — the one on the relocation/comp change ticket. Payroll date can be different but accrual rules follow the HR effective date.

mina_finance: note re: taxes and statutory holidays — UK employees get bank holidays; we don’t auto-convert unused US floating holidays into UK bank holidays. You can request a floating-day swap (ask people-ops) or take them as PTO.

rachel: ah ok. Any blackout exceptions around the year-end shutdown if I switch zones mid-window?

devon_peopleops: If you’re on a team scheduled for coverage during shutdown, we’ll coordinate with your manager. We prioritize pre-approved PTO before blackout but if your effective change falls inside the blackout window we typically require manager sign-off + People Ops approval to allow swapping.

rachel: timeline wise — when should I submit the swap/exception form?

sam_peopleops: As soon as relocation is entered is best. If it’s within 30 days of the blackout we need a quick manager note. Use this form: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/forms/pto-international-swap (fill section B for country change).

people-ops-bot: Reminder: submit relocation docs and the PTO swap form at least 10 business days before requested leave for manual approvals.

mina_finance: one more practical: balances will be shown in the old policy until HR completes the change. If you see anything off, ping payroll and cc people-ops.

rachel: great — filing relocation today, will attach manager note. thanks everyone :heart:

devon_peopleops: Thanks Rachel — ping me if you need help drafting the manager note, happy to jump on a quick call.

sam_peopleops: added a checklist in the thread for you: 1) submit relocation form; 2) submit PTO swap form (section B); 3) manager approval in thread or email; 4) confirm balance post-change with payroll.

rachel: checklist received, will follow up once forms are in.
